name: codex-jev-control
description: Local Jev hook control and health indicator for Codex in VS Code

codexJev.dataDirectory.description: Absolute PLUGIN_DATA directory for Codex Jev. Set this to the installed plugin data directory, or set CODEX_JEV_DATA_DIRECTORY.

codexJev.credentialDirectory.description: Windows user-local directory containing the DPAPI-protected Jev credential and request helper.

codexJev.mode.description: Jev output mode. Replacement is active when the hook is selected; observe only records decisions and keeps full output.
